name: How much does it cost to remove tree roots from a sewer line?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remove tree roots from a sewer line?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to remove tree roots varies significantly based on the severity of the root intrusion, the length of pipe affected, and the method used. Basic root removal with a hydro-jetting or augering service might range from a few hundred dollars. If pipe repair or replacement is needed due to damage, costs will be considerably higher. We provide detailed estimates after an inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on severity and method, from a few hundred for removal to more for pipe repair. Get an estimate after inspection.
